messages:
matt: Quick PIR scheduling for INC-2026-03 (payments timeout outage). Need a facilitator + date. Prefer next Thu or Wed — proposing Thu 16:00 UTC or Wed 16:00 UTC. Who can run this? Also need pre-read + confirmed action owners. cc @incident-bot for timeline link.

incident-bot: INC-2026-03 timeline: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-03 — runbook snapshot and pager logs attached.

leila: I can facilitate Thu 16:00 UTC. Happy to cover the canary trace section. :thumbsup:

sam: Thu 16:00 UTC conflicts for me (oncall until 17:00 UTC). If we move earlier to 15:00 UTC I can join. Otherwise I can hand off action list beforehand.

anya: I can note-take & collect action items. 16:00 UTC works for me if leila runs. Can someone prepare the pre-read with timeline + SLO graphs?

jordan: small timezone check — prefer Wed 15:00 PT option but want to avoid confusion. Let's stick to UTC options. Can we poll for two slots?

matt: Good call on timezones. Proposed two options: A) Thu 15:00 UTC (earlier so oncall can join) B) Wed 16:00 UTC. Please react to this thread: :thumbsup: for A, :eyes: for B. I'll close poll EOD PST.

leila: :+1: for A (Thu 15:00 UTC) — I can still run earlier.

sam: :eyes: need B if possible but I can hand off notes if the team prefers A.

anya: :thumbsup: A works for me.

incident-bot: Poll closed — option A (Thu 15:00 UTC) wins. Scheduling PIR Thu 15:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to attendees + pre-read link: https://redwood.docs/INC-2026-03-pre-read

matt: Thanks. Quick agenda draft:
```
- timeline recap (5m)
- impact & customer list (5m)
- root cause analysis (20m)
- actions & owners (15m)
- rollforward / mitigation notes (10m)
```
Leila — can you confirm you have the RCA draft? Sam — can you share the customer list?

leila: RCA draft in progress, will push to the doc by EOD. I'll include canary traces and failover timeline.

sam: Uploading customer-impact export now. Link: https://redwood.sheets/customer-impact-inc-2026-03 — includes affected accounts and timestamps.

anya: I'll drive action tracking during the meeting. Suggested quick action template: `owner | action | due | status`

jordan: Tentative owners based on what we discussed: infra -> sam, payments -> leila, monitoring -> anya. I'll update the tracker after the meeting with these assigned.

matt: Perfect. Two housekeeping things: 1) drop any extra logs or redflags into the pre-read doc under 'evidence' 2) if you cannot attend, add a delegate and update the calendar. I'll be the chair backup.

leila: Noted. Will add traces + link to staging heap dump.

sam: If I'm late, ping me in #incidents and I'll join asap. Also planning to hand off any open runbook steps to matt.

anya: I'll capture actions and create the tracker issue: GH-4821. Will post the link after the meeting.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: PIR Thu 15:00 UTC — 30 minutes. Pre-read available: https://redwood.docs/INC-2026-03-pre-read

matt: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread — see calendar invite. If anyone needs to change facilitator or add attendees, please ping me or update the invite.
